Question ID: ENV_U02_L01_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ENV.ECO.01

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Ecosystem Change and Succession
Stimulus: Succession model or ecosystem data

A student reviews the required environmental evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Identify the disturbance or starting condition. Then use the required stimulus (Succession model or ecosystem data) to connect the visible evidence to ecosystem change and succession evidence. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ENV.ECO.01 and avoids the common mistake: thinking succession is random replacement with no pattern.
